Class FundamentalSelector

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.fundamental.FundamentalSelector
public final class FundamentalSelector extends Object
Grades the stored fundamental rows of one security, so that per metric at most one row binds an expression variable. It is a pure function of the rows and a date: it reads no database and no price, which is why the checks that need the price ran earlier, at load time, and arrive here as sourceCheck.

Per bound metric, rows that failed their source check or are stale are not candidates. Yahoo share counts and revenue per share additionally require a passed share-basis check. Candidates are compared only with candidates of a comparable period; the most preferred candidate that agrees with another becomes CONFIRMED, a comparable group without any agreement becomes SUSPECT, and otherwise the most preferred candidate of the newest period becomes CHECKED or SINGLE. Finally the chosen fiscal year earnings are held against the chosen trailing twelve months earnings when three of their quarters overlap.
